settings.question: What is the Warranty?
settings.answer: Provence Natural Hardwood has a limited lifetime warranty. Review specific details on our Technical Documents page

settings.question: Can I DIY the installation?
settings.answer: No. Provence Natural Hardwood requires a professional installation for lasting performance.

settings.question: What documentation does my installer need to provide?
settings.answer: To ensure warranty coverage, the Installer is responsible for documenting all job site conditions at the time of installation. This includes the installation date, site relative humidity, temperature, and subfloor moisture content. You must retain these records, along with proof that the flooring was installed by a National Wood Flooring Association or Certified Floor Covering Installers certified professional

settings.question: How do I clean Provence Natural Hardwood?
settings.answer: Dry cleaning is preferred (sweeping, light vacuuming, dust mopping). Do not use steam mops, wet mops, or abrasive cleaners such as mineral spirits or bleach-based products. As the floor is already sealed, please avoid oil soaps and waxes.

settings.title: Highlights
settings.highlight_1_content: With Modin, we've redefined luxury vinyl plank flooring. Our Signature line features extra-large planks, enhanced bevels, and an industry-leading wear layer, setting a new benchmark in resilient flooring.
settings.highlight_2_content: Looking for something sleek and durable? Our Craftsman line offers the same exceptional durability as the Signature line but in a sleek, narrow plank style with subtle micro bevels.
settings.highlight_3_content: The Base line brings you the quality of Modin at an even more accessible price. Featuring smaller planks and less prominent bevels, it's a perfect choice for those seeking luxury on a budget.
settings.highlight_4_content: No matter which line you choose, you’ll enjoy true embossed-in-register texture, a low sheen level, a commercial-grade wear layer, a pre-attached underlayment, a rigid SPC core, and 100% waterproofing.
settings.highlight_5_title: Tailor Your Space with Versatile Options
settings.highlight_5_content: Select colors are available across Signature, Craftsman, and Base constructions, allowing you to find the perfect match for your space.

settings.title: Highlights
settings.highlight_1_content: Arista Laminate redefines eco-friendly flooring with its 100% PVC-free construction and sustainable cork underlayment. A stylish choice that’s better for your home—and the planet.
settings.highlight_2_content: Designed to handle the demands of daily life, Arista features water resistant protection—ideal for kitchens, busy households, and moisture-prone areas.
settings.highlight_3_content: With an industry-leading AC5 scratch rating, Arista is built to handle heavy foot traffic, pets, and everyday wear—keeping your floors looking flawless for years to come.
settings.highlight_4_content: Arista’s advanced locking system ensures a secure, hassle-free installation—no glue or nails required. Whether you're a seasoned pro or a first-time DIYer, upgrading your floors has never been easier.
settings.highlight_5_title: A Color to Suit Every Style
settings.highlight_5_content: From natural light browns to honey hues, subtle grey tones to rich medium browns, Arista offers a wide range of colors to complement any décor and bring your vision to life.

settings.title: Highlights
settings.highlight_1_content: Silvan Resilient Hardwood combines the finest sustainable materials with a focus on both durability and design. Crafted from 100% FSC-Certified European forests, each floor is not only stunning but also backed by a waterproof guarantee.
settings.highlight_2_content: Featuring extra-large planks, natural hardwood texture, and a subtle sheen, Silvan creates a luxurious look that will stand the test of time. Each plank is uniquely designed by nature, offering a floor that is truly yours.
settings.highlight_3_content: Silvan planks go beyond beauty. A UV-cured acrylic coating, high-density core, and cutting-edge locking mechanisms make them 3x harder than typical hardwood. Topically waterproof and impact-resistant, these planks are built for any situation.
settings.highlight_4_content: Together, these advanced features create the signature look and feel that defines Silvan Resilient Hardwood. It’s the ideal blend of natural elegance and modern strength.
